changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [utility].[FieldValue] with schemabinding AS SELECT T.ID AS FieldTypeID, A.ID AS AssetID, CASE WHEN T.AllowAllValue = 1 AND F.[Value] = '0' THEN CAST(T.AllowAllLabel AS nvarchar(max)) WHEN F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN F.FormattedValue WHEN T.DefaultFormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(T.DefaultFormattedValue AS nvarchar(max)) ELSE NULL END AS FormattedValue FROM dbo.Asset AS A INNER JOIN dbo.FieldType AS T ON T.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Field AS F ON F.FieldTypeID = T.ID AND F.ObjectType = A.Object AND F.ObjectID = A.ObjectID
